content.statement: Shannon entropy H(X) = −∑ p(x) log₂ p(x).
content.explanation: H(X) measures average information content. Maximum for uniform distribution. Additive for independent variables. Mutual information I(X;Y) = H(X)+H(Y)−H(X,Y). Conditional entropy H(X|Y)=H(X,Y)−H(Y).
keyTakeaways: Shannon entropy H(X) = −∑ p(x) log₂ p(x).
Know what problem or physical phenomenon 20.1 Classical Information addresses.
Be able to interpret every symbol and state the assumptions behind the formula.

content.statement: von Neumann entropy S(ρ) = −Tr(ρ log ρ).
content.explanation: Eigenvalue form: S(ρ) = −∑ λᵢ log λᵢ. S=0 iff pure, max log d. Quantum mutual information I(A;B)=S(ρ_A)+S(ρ_B)−S(ρ_AB). Conditional entropy S(A|B)=S(ρ_AB)−S(ρ_B) can be negative for entangled states (e.g., |Φ⁺⟩ → S(A|B)=−1). Relative entropy S(ρ||σ)=Tr(ρ log ρ − ρ log σ).
keyTakeaways: von Neumann entropy S(ρ) = −Tr(ρ log ρ).
Know what problem or physical phenomenon 20.2 Quantum Information addresses.
Be able to interpret every symbol and state the assumptions behind the formula.

codeExamples.code:
from qiskit import QuantumCircuit
from qiskit.quantum_info import Statevector
import json

LESSON_ID = '20-20-3-quantum-channels'
circuit = QuantumCircuit(1)
circuit.h(0)
sv = Statevector.from_instruction(circuit)
rho = sv.to_operator().data @ (sv.to_operator().data.conj().T)
print(json.dumps({'lesson': LESSON_ID, 'statevector': [complex(a).__repr__() for a in sv.data], 'rho': [[complex(x).__repr__() for x in row] for row in rho]}))

content.statement: χ = S(∑ pᵢ ρᵢ) − ∑ pᵢ S(ρᵢ).
content.explanation: The Holevo bound is the maximum classical information that can be extracted from a quantum ensemble. It implies n qubits transmit at most n classical bits.
keyTakeaways: χ = S(∑ pᵢ ρᵢ) − ∑ pᵢ S(ρᵢ).

content.statement: Classical: I(X;Z) ≤ I(X;Y) for Markov chain X→Y→Z. Quantum: S(ℰ(ρ)||ℰ(σ)) ≤ S(ρ||σ).
content.explanation: Information cannot increase under processing (no free lunch).
keyTakeaways: Classical: I(X;Z) ≤ I(X;Y) for Markov chain X→Y→Z.
